capabilities: Ask an AI model questions from a modal, ribbon icon, command, or editor context menu
Send selected text or the full note as context
Copy, insert, or replace text with the AI response
Configure base URL, API key, model, and max tokens
Connect to OpenAI, DeepSeek, or any custom OpenAI-compatible API
extras: Manual installation path requires cloning the repo and running npm install and npm run dev; README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask an AI model for suggestions, edits, or explanations using the current note as context.

relations.evidence: Since the AI Bot plugin uses the OpenAI Node API Library at its core
DeepSeek: Access deepseek-chat model on DeepSeek.
OpenAI: Utilize models like GPT-3, GPT-4, and others from OpenAI.

requires.name: account with an AI service (OpenAI, DeepSeek, or custom)

summary: AI assistant modal that sends queries with note or selection context to an AI service and can insert or replace the response text.
